en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Everything from Himiko's show is completely
gone. Monokuma must have cleaned it up.

<CLT=cltMIND>But...the sight of Ryoma's body...
It's engraved into our minds. We'll never forget.
<CLT=cltMIND>This monitor has to be custom made...

<CLT=cltMIND>Why go out of their way to make this?
Where is this budget coming from?
